authority.review_import_note: Imported existing verified EN/FR preview inputs, including previously approved numeric corrections; inventory below describes actual candidate bytes, not untouched upstream bytes.

normalizations.change: Remove extra AC-input bypass line absent in released PDF; retain bypass output and add its exact EN/FR footnote.

Trim trailing RST whitespace/blank EOF lines and lengthen STORAGE heading underline to avoid a Git conflict-marker false positive; preserve LF CSV checkout using existing frozen-source gitattributes convention.

Restore safety condition, LCD mapping/copy, electrical maximum, native USB-C rows, troubleshooting, section order and App numbering; remove PDF-absent copy. Preserve documented authority-side inconsistencies.

Bind one shared finished panel (web-composite/je1000f_eu/reference.app-connect-result, locale=shared) cropped from the EN block with its 2.3/2.4/2.5 captions; the FR/ES/DE/IT blocks print the same English screens. It replaces the JP-market shared app/connect_result art the Web pages showed.

Switch the raw paths to the shared JP-market app/add_device and app/connect_result screenshots in the FR/ES/DE/IT/UK pages and the DE/ES/IT/UK generated drafts to asset:app/add_device and asset:app/connect_result, which the reviewed promotion je1000f-eu-app-ui-v1 resolves to the EU print's own screens (the same change as Hello-Docs #125 on review/JE-1000F-EU).

normalizations.scope: In-box, LCD display mode and UPS review pages
normalizations.change: Switch the raw shared-art paths and bare basenames for in_the_box/main_unit1, operation/lcd_mode and operation/ups_mode in the FR/ES/DE/IT/UK pages, the DE/ES/IT/UK generated drafts and the EN in-box LaTeX macro to asset:in_the_box/main_unit1, asset:operation/lcd_mode and asset:operation/ups_mode. The JE-1000F/EU target overrides resolve them to the released print's own blocks (the English block's BS 1363 sockets for en, the French block's EU sockets for fr/es/de/it/uk) instead of the shared art (a US-outlet unit and another, wheeled model).
